content_patterns: Sectioned form: each field group wrapped in its own white card with uppercase, letter-spaced labels. Explicit '(OPTIONAL)' annotation. Placeholder uses concrete examples ('e.g. Weekly Groceries'). Currency embedded in label ('AMOUNT (RP)') and value. Line-item entry as a 3-column mini-table (NAME / QTY / PRICE) with a dashed '+ Add Item' repeater. Explanatory subtitle: 'Manual entry for un-scanned receipts.' Verb-first CTA with icon: 'Save Expense'.
notable_interactions: Date field with dual calendar icons implies a date picker. Category dropdown with checkmark implies selectable list (likely bottom-sheet/dropdown). '+ Add Item' dashed button implies repeatable line-item rows for itemized entry. Large 'Rp 0' amount implies numeric keypad-style entry. 'Save Expense' implies form submission. Back arrow implies cancel/return. Amount field styling matches other amount inputs in the app for consistency.
